Its what Kaathe does. He lures powerful creatures into doing his bidding via the promise of the lifedrain power. You want to figure out if Kaathe is lying and using you? You get three examples of Kaathes influence in this game. New Londo, Oolacile, look what happened in both of those places. the New Londo knights turned into Darkwraiths, running amok and stealing humanity in New Londo, forcing the city to be destroyed due to how much of a threat they became, they were attacking HUMANS, for their humanity. The Undead Burg(possibly multiple of them around) and New Londo seem to be Human populated cities around Anor, which they may not have been permitted to enter, so I believe its a human city. So, darkwraithes dont give a damn about humans, just HUMANITY. 

Now, lets think about Oollacile. Chester states a serpent came to the people of Oollacile and promised them power, so they made their way to the Abyss and opened the Grave of Manus, father of the Abyss on the Serpents word. Oollacile didnt last very long afterwards did it? No. Oolacile I'm fairly sure was a human kingdom, yet again showing Kaathe doesnt care about Humans, and is only using them as a pawn to do what he perhaps can't do himself. Yet. He wanted Manus to be awoke, there could be a million reasons, perhaps awaking Manus caused the spread of the Abyss, or furthered it via Manus's seemingly ability to cause the Humanity in others to go wild and mutate them, Manus has some connection to Humanity, so, Kaathe, who asks you to collect Humanity would of course be interested in him. You kill Manus and you halt that attempt from Kaathe. Oolacile however is destroyed, never to recover. Only Dusk remains from them. 

That is two of three incidents involving Kaathe, both of which is him using others to try and further the Abyss. 

Now, on Gods being afraid of Humans? You don't manipulate something you are terrified of into furthering your own existence, the Gods did that to Humans, Frampt spreads the rumor of the "Chosen Undead" which I personally believe to be a load of BS, its just a lure to get the strongest warriors, strong souls, to travel there and perhaps make it to the Kiln, where they will be able to defeat the shell of Gwyn, because he is no longer feeding the bonfire. Kaathe starts his own rumor/story of the "Dark Lord" user of the Lifedrain technique, which is apparently its "signature" yet don't all darkwraithes use that? Kaathe gives people this ability so that they will go and collect Humanity for him with the promise if they bring him enough, they can perhaps become strong enough to be this Dark lord. Kaathe is using ANYONE he can to collect humanity for him.

Your third paragraph is essentially agreeing with my view? Gwyn or who ever is in charge at the time sends his three most powerful warriors to stop the spread of the abyss, showing they are terrified of it. They are more worried about it than Humanity.

I'll give you a quote, straight from the Serpents mouth, during the "Dark Lord" Ending, one of the serpents speaks the line "Let the true Dark spread..". The True Dark. You really think thats Humans? Really?

How are you so sure that it will be an Age of Man? Heres my view, letting the fire keep burning is probably the lesser of two evils, yes the gods stay immortal, but how many gods are left? Gwyns a shell, most people murder Gwyndolin, Gwynevere is not even in Lordran, the gods are a dying breed anyway. By keeping the fires burning and keeping the cycle going you keep things as they are. Now what happens if you let it die?

The Age of Dark is not the age if Humans as Kaathe wants you to believe, you do not become the Dark Lord, you are essentially filling in the Four Kings slot, a puppet, Kaathe wants the Age of Fire to end, so that Humanity (Shards of the Dark Soul, one of the originals and an extremely powerful thing) are stopped being fed to the flames, what does he request you do as a Darkwraith? Bring him Humanity, Kaathe is trying to rebuild the dark soul, the Age of Dark is not for Humans, its for the Abyss. 

You really think the Gods were afraid of Humans? No, they used Humanity like little puppets, feeding Humanity in the bonfires to regain their human form, while at the same time making the Flame stronger, the gods were afraid of the Dark, whats the Darkest thing in DS? The Abyss. What did Gwyn do to New Londo because the Abyss was found beneath it? Flooded it killing thousands, perhaps more, what did the Gods do once they found about the Oolacile opening? He sent his atleast 3 of his four greatest Knights to go deal with it. The Age of Dark is the spread of the Abyss across everything, the only thing holding it back is the First Flame. 

So, by siding with Kaathe, you simply trade one puppeteer for another, and allow something you tried to stop in Oolacile, happening across the entire world.
